caption: MCP Server Capabilities
description: Capabilities that a server may support. Known capabilities are defined here, in this schema, but this is not a closed set: any server can define its own, additional capabilities. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 ServerCapabilities; 2026-07-28 ServerCapabilities).
name: mcp_server_capabilities

mcp_completions.description: MCP member `completions`: Present if the server supports argument autocompletion suggestions.

mcp_experimental.description: MCP member `experimental`: Experimental, non-standard capabilities that the server supports.

mcp_logging.description: MCP member `logging`: Present if the server supports sending log messages to the client.

mcp_server_capabilities__prompts.description: MCP member `prompts`: Present if the server offers any prompt templates.

mcp_server_capabilities__resources.description: MCP member `resources`: Present if the server offers any resources to read.

mcp_server_capabilities__tasks.description: MCP member `tasks`: Present if the server supports task-augmented requests.

mcp_server_capabilities__tools.description: MCP member `tools`: Present if the server offers any tools to call.

mcp_extensions.description:
MCP member `extensions`: Optional MCP extensions that the server supports. Keys are extension identifiers
(e.g., "io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks"), and values are per-extension settings
objects. An empty object indicates support with no settings.

Keys MUST follow the {@link MetaObject`_meta` key naming rules}, with a
mandatory prefix.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
